from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re
base = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-community-directory')
readme = (base / 'raw/awesome-sqlite-readme.md').read_text()
patch_bytes = (base / 'raw/merged-pr-43.patch.txt').read_bytes()
digest = hashlib.sha256(patch_bytes).hexdigest()
assert digest == '190ebbbebb7dad846719860e716cda17e4f10467c04aac088a774b9cfa23c122'
section = ''
entries = []
for line in readme.splitlines():
    if line.startswith('#'):
        section = line.strip('# ')
    if re.match(r'^\s*[-*]\s+\[', line) and re.search(r'query|debug|diagnos|statement|explain', line, re.I):
        entries.append({'section': section, 'entry': line.strip()[:320]})
readme_diff = False
additions = []
for line in patch_bytes.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').splitlines():
    if line.startswith('diff --git '):
        readme_diff = line.split()[-1].lower().endswith('/readme.md')
    if readme_diff and re.match(r'^\+\s*[-*]\s+\[', line):
        additions.append(line[1:].strip()[:320])
result = {'patch_url': 'https://patch-diff.githubusercontent.com/raw/planetopendata/awesome-sqlite/pull/43.patch', 'patch_sha256': digest, 'merged_patch_readme_link_additions': additions[:8], 'merged_patch_readme_link_addition_count': len(additions), 'candidate_neighbors': entries[:3], 'invitation_observed': 'Contributions welcome. Anything missing? Send in a pull request. Thanks.' in readme, 'limits': 'One merged patch and a keyword screen of the current README. Check comparability and contribution eligibility before an operator handoff.'}
output = base / 'pr43-placement-evidence.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
print(output.read_text())
